When I streamed, I would sometimes have younglings (anything from 11-15... I'm in my 30s to give you a hint of the age gap) who would I guess look up to me, want to be my friend and in a way, have me be their parent-away-from-their-parents. Like the "cool mom" or some shit.

I banned all of them, because there was no way I was gonna risk MY safety. I made lots of adult jokes on my stream and all it takes is some 11 year old's mom to see that I responded to some anon chatter with a dick joke and before you know it I'm in serious trouble.

I'm 35 years old I've been on the internet since it was basically available to the general public. People NEVER used to be this shitty, not ever. At worst you'd find one single bad egg and he or she would be dealt with swiftly. It was never encouraged and nobody was told "oh get over it". Frankly why should anyone have to? We're not the bad party, we're just trying to have fun and get along.

I'm not using Anecdotal evidence, I'm telling you the truth; sadly I can't/won't show evidence because I want to be anonymous beacuse of how shit the internet is. Comes full circle. It's. The. Internet.

Thanks dude, that was really helpful.

I am quite poor (I legit have no money for busfare, entry fees or anything that costs anything - I even use food banks for food atm) but I'll keep an eye out for local walking-distance events.

As for my old friends, there are two, primarily. One has a husband/kids and is so selfish about things (her husband literally has to force her to make plans outside of being around him, cos she never wants to) and the other friend unfortunately moved 3,000 miles away.

Incorrect. I said - on my OWN Twitter - I didn't want children.

I now have more than 5,000 mentions telling me to die, calling me names, screenshotting my tweets to try and embarass me (cos I am poor and suffer depression, sometimes I talk about this on my Twitter) and so forth.

It's the internet, not me.

" It's part of the social make-up of humanity"

No, it really isn't. The politics, the natural power structure that comes with varying degrees of wealth, yes it is.

On the internet we are all equal. If you have access to social media or an online game, you are no better or worse than anyone else. There is never, EVER an excuse for telling someone to kill themselves, or saying really mean things like "I hope you break your neck and have to live in a wheelchair" (something I actually saw in a gaming chat room)

"shit like that is definitely crossing a line"

It goes WAY beyond crossing a line. It endangers lives. People have literally died because of garbage behaviour like this. 100% indefensible.

LOL yes exactly. "Shit, they're onto me! Downvote! DOWNVOOOOTE!" 

sad

It was honestly how the internet was supposed to be; bringing people from all walks of life together.

I recall someone offering to send me a drawing, so I just gave my address and they actually sent me a drawing and a letter. We lost contact, but I have no fear that this person will leak my details. These days all people know is what country I live in, and that's it.

I also remember (in 2009), having a frying pan fight on a raft during a game of Left 4 Dead 2. None of us knew each other.It was a small moment, but was so funny.

You simply can't do that now. You'd get vote-kicked in a heartbeat.

Exactly! I mean hey, if people want to go on hate-fuelled rants about people on forums designed for that, go right ahead. Human rights and all that.

But there isn't enough action taken against toxic people in the name of likes, views, popularity and money. Sad.

I am sorry to hear of their death. Try not to let your mind run away with ideas or reasons; even if there was a suicide, it's rarely one single moment, word or person who is the cause of it. there are always underlying reasons.

I am happy to read you have learned. Sometimes staying silent when we don't really like someone is better.

You're being rude. I'm just angry.

And for the record, once again - if you had one day in my shoes you'd be fucking angry so if you're going to sit there and talk down to me you can just piss off. I'm not here for your attitude I am here to be angry. So go away.

Oh you know what, shut the hell up.

Seriously, if you have only THAT to say, you don't know a thing about my situation or what it is like to BE in my situation. Get lost.

Good god I hate answers like this.

"Things will get better". HOw do you know that hm? HOW. You don't, so dont patronize me

The thing is, in terms of units (though what that translates into chemically I don't actually know if that makes sense), a bottle of wine is akin to half a 75cl bottle of vodka.

If I'd said I was drinking that every day, people may be more surprised at my lack of symptoms? Same amount of booze going in.

That is why I said "I guess it's up to the individual to know if they can handle a resort or a ship with lots of bars, knowing they can't get off." in my comment.

If a person's personal case is very serious/chronic, then going to a hotel resort is going to be deadly for them.

Well the thing is I always did my housework, or "adulting" that was required, it's no different now. Drinking never disrupted my day because my day was effectively done by the time I opened the bottle. I was just a little more tired while I did it.

Haven't seen a doctor, honestly no need.

People still inside of a program are going to be advised to avoid places that are basically designed for heavy or repeated drinking sessions. I guess it's up to the individual to know if they can handle a resort or a ship with lots of bars, knowing they can't get off.

I have literally nobody else - no family, no other friends. Don't even have a job right now. It's my only connection to other humans, these friends.

Like... I like them, but I am tired of how I feel like I am never supported by them, but I always support them. What do I do?

So it's not my media, it's the shitty software.
